note: Curated, well-known Hydra extensions. URLs come from each project’s README; see verified.how. Nothing here is fetched until the owner installs it, and plugins only ever run inside the sandboxed preview frame.

plugins.name: hydra-motion
plugins.author: hydra-motion contributors
plugins.description: Glides, holds and pads: knob() values that glide (k.to), jump (k.set) and hold momentarily (k.hold / k.release), and gate() envelopes. Adds the globals knob, gate and hydraMotion.

verified.how: Built from packages/motion in this repository and served by this site at a versioned path; the SRI is generated from the built file at every build (scripts/sync-motion.mjs).

plugins.name: hydra-midi
plugins.author: Arno Schlipf (arnoson)
plugins.description: MIDI notes and CCs as Hydra parameters: midi.start(), note(), cc(), .adsr/.range/.smooth. Adds globals, not catalog functions.

verified.how: README documents https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hydra-midi@<version>/dist/index.js and pinning a version; npm hydra-midi@0.4.6 (latest) contains dist/index.js (9.4 kB). jsDelivr itself was not reachable from the build container.

kinds.functions: only registers Hydra functions with setFunction (they appear in every editor’s picker)
kinds.mixed: registers functions and adds JavaScript globals or methods
kinds.js: adds JavaScript globals or methods only; uses stay editable text
